title: VEILSHARD
subtitle: Fractured Oath
opening: The Core has shattered. Follow its echoes through a world losing its balance.
introductions: Embers drift beneath a silent canopy. A guardian bars the path to the first fragment.
Frost seals the old ruins. Something stirs beneath the broken archway.
Lightning circles a deserted tower. A figure gathers the storm at its summit.
The grove still breathes, but its roots carry a strange corruption.
Beyond the fractured gates, the last guardian waits beside the scattered light.
ending: The fragments resonate together. Balance begins to return, but the truth behind the fracture remains unwritten.
